findings.description: cachekey is `"http://"+host+target+"\n"+val(h,"accept-encoding")`. `val` returns the empty string for both an absent header and an empty `Accept-Encoding:` value, so a client sending `Accept-Encoding:` populates the exact key a client with no header reads. A gzip body cached under that key is then replayed to a bare client with `Content-Encoding: gzip`, an encoding it never asked for. Precondition: cache enabled, upstream stores `public, max-age`.
findings.title: An empty Accept-Encoding header aliases the no-header cache key, so a gzip body is replayed to a bare client

limitations: All RCE is RCE on the upstream host
Needs a cache-enabled config and an upstream that sends Cache-Control: public, max-age=
